search_results.question: What is the current limitation when using MLP speculators for speculative decoding in vLLM?
search_results.answer: The current limitation when using MLP speculators for speculative decoding in vLLM is that these models currently need to be run without tensor parallelism, although it is possible to run the main model using tensor parallelism (see example above). This limitation will be fixed in a future release.
